1.mascotDialogue: Every node only knows one thing about neighbour: where next one is. Lose that pointer... gone. Like that. Let's see in C, can already.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 3. Whole trick there. `next` is pointer to another Node, not value. `createNode` set it to NULL first, every time. New node never assume it knows what's next.

3.mascotDialogue: Hover any line left side, watch which node light up right side. `head->next->next`? Just follow arrow twice. That's all, nothing more.

4.mascotDialogue: Node 2 arrow point to nothing. See? Not the picture playing punk on you — that's the honest truth of the pointer. Code never tell it go anywhere else.
